field_changes.old: No major fixes or big changes to report, just tuning things up to keep the app running smoothly.
field_changes.new:
Fixed: If you multi-day logged a recipe from My Recipes, nothing you logged would show up. Now your multi-day logs land exactly where and when you want them to.

For those using GLP-1 support, the legal disclaimer sheet was cutting off text and hiding the close button at larger accessibility text sizes. Now everything fits, no matter the text size.

*Bye bye buggos! We scooped'em up with a paper cup and let'em go outside.

*For all the latest fixes, update to the latest app version
